messages:
Maya R (AE): Quick — Prospect ClearEdge needs a compact assurance bundle for procurement before POC: SOC2 excerpt, ISO cert, signed pen-test attestation, and a one-paragraph note on Dedicated pricing/ETA. Need reply today.

Jon C (Solutions): I can pull SOC2 summary + ISO pdf and add a sanitized staging diagram. Will also draft the Dedicated cost blurb (uplist + provisioning ETA).

Priya N (Security): We have a one-page pen-test attestation template. We require the exact recipient "TO:" line and their ack of our template. We can sign within 48h after that. Redactions of IPs/scan logs are standard.

Dana L (Legal): Legal signs as 'Redwood Inference, Inc. Legal Counsel (on behalf of Security)'. Need recipient legal name and confirmation they accept our template. Will sign within 48h of confirmation.

Eli W (Infra): Dedicated baseline estimate: $7,500/mo, one-time setup $3,500; provisioning ETA ~6 business days after PO. If they want customer-managed KMS add ~ $1,200/mo + $3k one-time and ~ 10 business days ETA. Prefer 3hr external scan window Tue 09:00-12:00 UTC.

Jon C (Solutions): Creating dataroom and uploading drafts, will paste link in a few mins.

DataroomBot: Assurance dataroom ready: https://dataroom.redwood/assurance/CLEAREDGE-5943211111 (view-only). Uploaded: soc2-exec-summary.pdf, iso27001-cert.pdf, pen-test-attestation-template.docx (unsigned), dedicated-pricing-note.txt, presigned-readme.md

Maya R (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll send the dataroom to ClearEdge now, ask for the exact TO: line and whether they want Dedicated+CMK. I'll update when they reply. :pray:
